newsitem.title: USA: Republican Industries acquires car dealer.
newsitem.headline: Republican Industries acquires car dealer.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said Tuesday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Courtesy Auto Group Inc, which owns and operates a variety of car dealerships in the Orlando area.
The transaction is value at about $30 million in Republic common stock.

When the deal is closed, Kim Hackett will remain as president of Courtesy and Courtesy Chairman and Chief Executive will remain with the company as an executive adviser, the company said. Courtesy owns and operates Saturn, Pontiac, Acura, Isuzu, Suzuki and Kia dealerships.
